selection_rule: threshold inherited unchanged from phase 2 (0.2, max dev F1); dtype/threads/batch varied for throughput only, chosen on reports/phase4_perf/comparison.json
change_scope: performance only: same weights revision, same prompts, same chunking, same threshold, same fusion; no safety check was disabled

measured.probe_set: 60 synthetic notes, span sets identical for all five configs (agreement 1.0)

frozen_test_regression.reading: fp32 vs fp16 changes three borderline decisions across 632 documents. Every difference is an ADDED span: ZH-0140 phone 88-99 is a correct recovery (+1 TP for C), the other two are new false positives (EN-0554 '50-year-old male' labelled NAME in a document with no gold entities). Recall is unchanged for the deployed method D; precision moves by 0.0004. The threshold was NOT re-tuned after seeing this.

why_not_batching: batched chunks pad to the longest chunk in the batch; the encoder is compute-bound on this CPU, so padding waste exceeds the per-call overhead saving. Length-sorted batching recovers part of the loss but still loses to one document at a time.
notes: fp16 on this CPU has no fast GEMM kernel; onnxruntime inserted Cast nodes taking 24.5% of runtime. fp32 conversion is the official onnx/model.onnx of the same repository revision, sha256 7704865e414f24591da6aee08716a25677855bc8a84af81396d90e40df1e68d2
